question: When was the last time it snowed in england on christmas day?
text:
The most recent Christmas Day snow I could confirm in the UK was in **2023**. The Met Office counts a "white Christmas" if even a single snowflake is observed falling on 25 December. In 2023, 11% of Met Office stations reported falling snow, although there was no snow lying on the ground.

- **Last widespread snow:** The last time there was widespread snow on Christmas Day in the UK was in 2010, when 83% of stations had snow on the ground, the highest percentage ever recorded.
- **London:** One report says London's last technical white Christmas was in 2022 (as of its 2024 article). It also says the last time snow covered rooftops and roads on the day in the capital was 1999.
- **2024 and 2025:** The forecasts I found for both years pointed away from snow. In 2024 the Met Office said Christmas Day was likely to be settled, often cloudy and dry for the majority. In 2025 the chance of snow falling was "relatively low". I couldn't find the official Met Office results for either year, so I can't say for certain that no snow fell somewhere in England on those days.

In England, then, falling snow was last confirmed on Christmas Day in 2023, and snow actually settling on the ground was last widespread in 2010.
